clips.title: The story
paras: Essential Artificials is an Alliance quest offered by Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge's Tinker Town. Tasked with plumbing the depths of the irradiated ruins of Gnomeregan, adventurers must recover crucial universal components that were abandoned during the gnomes' desperate evacuation.

When the trogg invasion overwhelmed Gnomeregan and toxic radiation flooded its corridors, the fleeing gnomes could only carry what was immediately at hand. Among the countless marvels left behind were supplies of essential artificials—specialized, nigh-universal mechanical components prized by tinkers and crafters. Now operating out of Tinker Town in Ironforge, master tinker Klockmort Spannerspan finds his groundbreaking new experiments stalled without them.

These vital devices are housed within heavy, steam-powered storage units known as artificial extrapolators located deep within the fallen city. Salvaging them requires braving irradiated halls crawling with mutated leper gnomes, malfunctioning defense automatons, and feral troggs. Recovering a cache of twelve components allows Klockmort to resume his critical work, pushing gnomish innovation forward despite their exile.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A nigh-universal mechanical component--the essential artificial--was of great use to the tinkers and smiths of Gnomeregan. But during the frantic exodus from our city, no one remembered to take any of these devices with them! And I need a large supply of them for work I will soon undertake.
Please, go into Gnomeregan and get me some essential artificials. You'll find them in the deeper areas of our city, held in containers called artificial extrapolators.
Thank you, friend, and please hurry!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the essential artificials?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You got them! Now I can begin my new experiments!
I can't thank you enough, friend! You're bravery has advanced gnomish research by a leap and a bound!
